title: Explainable ML for SMS Scam Detection (Kenyan mobile-money context)
threshold_rule: highest threshold with >=95% out-of-fold scam recall
intended_use: Educational/research prototype: flag possibly suspicious SMS for human review.
not_for: Automatic blocking; legal or financial decisions; non-Kenyan or non-SMS contexts.
caveats: Labels are annotations, not verified truth
Class mix is not real-world prevalence
Genuine M-Pesa receipts may be flagged
Link-free social-engineering scams may be missed
